newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 222 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 222 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totaled 222 contracts versus 527 contracts traded overnight Wednesday.
There were seven wheat, corn volume was not reported, 186 soybean, 18 soymeal, 10 corn call and one corn put traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1/2 to two cents higher corn was unchanged to 3/4 higher and soybeans were 1/2 to 1-3/4 higher.
